title: The Fortune Teller
text: An old woman with a deck of cards sits on a rock. She will read for one of you, for free; the cards, she says, are the price.

options.label: The leader has their cards read.

outcomes.text: She turns a card over, and it is not the one the leader was born under.

options.label: The wisest listens from the edge.

outcomes.text: Every reading she gives is a little true. The wisest learns how she does it.
She laughs, and shuffles, and lays one card face up on the rock as you go: the Tower. You all walk faster after that.

options.label: The Soothsayer reads for her instead.

outcomes.text: She goes white at the third card, and pays them to stop.
